transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you. What brings you in to see me today?

Hello. Um... well... I guess I'm here because it's just been a bit stressful lately. I'm a financial advisor here in Cincinnati, and... I don't know, it's a bit hard to explain. 

I've just been noticing some things. It feels like certain people in the arts and finance circles around here are... well, tracking which clients I meet with. And they sort of send me these little signals about it. Like through event invitations, or... or panel topics, even just who they seat near me at dinners. 

I keep trying to tell myself it could just be a coincidence, but... I just can't really let it go. So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Have you been feeling unusually high-spirited or energetic, or perhaps exceptionally down or hopeless, during the time you've been noticing these signals?
Um... no. Not really. I mean, I'm just... regular, I guess. I haven't felt super energetic or... or really down. Just stressed out by everything I mentioned. But my mood is... it's fine.

Have you noticed any other changes in your life, such as difficulty organizing your thoughts, or perhaps feeling like you've become less motivated or less interested in doing things you usually enjoy?

Um... I guess so. I mean, work gets done, eventually. Just... in pieces. 

I don't really have the same... spark, I suppose. Like, client follow-ups just sit there. And I've been skipping things I usually do. Jazz nights, pickup basketball... I just don't really care to go. 

When people ask about it, I just... keep it short. Talking just feels like a lot of effort lately.
Do you ever hear voices or sounds that other people around you cannot hear?
Um... no. Not really. I don't hear anything like that. Just... normal sounds, I guess. Nothing out of the ordinary.
When you are speaking to others, do you find that your thoughts sometimes get jumbled or that people have trouble following what you are trying to say?
Um... no. Not really. I think I make sense. People don't... they don't say anything about it. I just don't talk much right now.
Have you noticed any changes in your daily habits, such as neglecting your personal hygiene or acting in ways that others might find strange or unusual?
Um... no. Not really. I just... I shower and get dressed like always. I haven't noticed anything strange. I'm just doing what I normally do.
How long have you been feeling that these people are tracking your meetings and sending you these signals?
Um... maybe about two months. Give or take. That's just when I started noticing it... during my client meetings.
Have you ever felt like you could smell, taste, or feel things on your skin that others around you could not perceive?
No... I haven't. I don't really know what you mean by that, but... no. Everything's just normal with that.
Do you ever wonder if there might be any other explanation for these events, or are you certain that these people are intentionally sending you signals?

Um... sometimes I try to tell myself that it could just be a coincidence. But... I don't know, I can't really let it go. I'm just convinced that certain people in the arts and finance circles here in Cincinnati are quietly tracking which clients I meet with. It's just... the way they send me these little signals through invitations, or... panel topics. Even who they have sit near me at events. So... yeah. I can't really just write it off as something else.
Have you noticed any other unusual experiences or changes in your behavior that you haven't mentioned yet?

Not really. I mean... maybe just that I don't have the same spark lately. I still get my work done, just... in pieces. I'll let client follow-ups sit. 

I haven't really been going to jazz nights or playing pickup basketball either, and... I don't really care that I'm missing it. Friends ask what's going on, but I just give them short answers. Talking just feels like more effort than it should right now. But that's about it.
